title: Phase-Field Modeling of Fracture with Physics-Informed Deep Learning
authors: M. Manav; R. Molinaro; S. Mishra; L. De Lorenzis
source: /Users/wenxiaofang/obsidian/01 Research Tracks/Paper Reading/1 paper 原稿/Manav et al - 2024 - Phase-field modeling of fracture with physics-informed deep learning - arXiv v1.pdf
specific_gap: Is the paper's quasistatic shear benchmark a reasonable basis for the current FEM/PIDL comparison, and is the current setup an equivalent reproduction?
summary: 通过能量最小化学习准静态相场断裂；SEN剪切考察裂缝转向并与FEM对比。
research_question: 能量、表示、求积和优化器设计能否使神经网络学到复杂断裂局部能量极小值？本次重点是SEN剪切对照。
method: Deep Ritz; AT1; volumetric-deviatoric split; plane strain; hard displacement ansatz; finite irreversibility penalty; T3 nodal interpolation and one-point integration; transfer learning across load steps.
data_setting: Synthetic 1x1 SEN; nu=.3; ell=.01; omega=0; 8x400 adaptive-ReLU networks, m0=3, 8 initializations; Q4 FEM comparator.
main_result: Fig.11 compares NN/FEM at Up=.4 and Fig.13 energies agree closely with a slightly higher NN critical load. FEM convergence issues are reported for Up>.4; Fig.12 at .47 is NN only.
positive_evaluation: 旋转载荷检验转向机制；并列场与能量比较；报告多初始化变化和FEM失败范围。
negative_evaluation: .4以上缺成功FEM参照；理想化准静态算例不支持真实道路或疲劳结论；当前协议若直接称复现，会掩盖罚项、初始场、网络和积分差异。
limitation_evidence: Section 4.4.2 pp21-22; conclusion pp27-28; Appendix G pp41-42; comparison with frozen R007 source and prepared PIDL runner.
neutral_implication: 剪切方向合理；可前瞻地分为目标至.4的共同验证范围与独立NN延伸范围，不能追溯改变既有30状态协议或把失败状态纳入比较。
gap_dimensions: Supports geometry, loading mode, main energy model and matched-displacement field/energy comparison; does not establish exact current reproduction or a successful paired result.
gap_rationale: Major physical choices agree, but initialization/recovery, FEM TOLir (.001 paper vs .005 current), NN size/m0/seeds, and penalty quadrature differ. Current FEM has 12 accepted states through .28, with .29 stopped; no PIDL result exists.
gap_evidence: Eq.17-18; Eq.29; Section 4.1; Section 4.4.2; Appendix G and I; frozen R007 run_shear_fem_r007.m; scripts/shear/run_shear_pidl.py; S04-E035 experiment.md.
code_data_availability: v1 p28 says code will be made available at publication. Current public code and an exact version binding were not verified in this reading.
reproducibility_risk: Full shear load list and exact residual stiffness not established; paper and current implementation use different initialization, FEM penalty and NN configurations; paper does not establish the cause of the current earlier convergence stop.
next_action: Prepare a prospective paper-aligned comparison contract, retaining current negative evidence and execution boundaries. No FEM, PIDL, SSH, retry or training launched by this reading.
